programmes.programName: Doctor of Philosophy in Business Administration
programmes.evidence: Official PhD overview explicitly links its academic research programme to Supply Chain CESIT; curriculum requires independent research and defended three-paper thesis. Linked CESIT research explicitly includes maritime/sustainable supply chains, urban logistics and analytics, with doctoral researchers. MOSI department page associates its staff with CESIT.
limitations: One broad PhD across Bordeaux, Marseille and Paris; Supply Chain is a directly linked research pathway, not an invented named concentration or separately awarded degree. MOSI academic association does not establish exclusive administrative doctoral ownership.

branches.conclusion: Full current academic programme inventory, PhD overview/curriculum and directly linked Supply Chain research scope verified. One eligible broad Business Administration PhD retained. Other research-centre topics do not create separate degree awards.

Full academic department and programme inventories show business-school provision, no engineering PhD or department. Business Engineering wording in non-doctoral teaching is not Industrial Engineering doctoral provision.

sources.note: Entire displayed official MOSI department overview read: exact Operations Management and Information Systems Academic Department, KEDGE Business School; purchasing, supply chain, quality, project management, urban logistics, maritime/air transport. Explicit MOSI staff membership of CESIT. Educational Team accordion not expanded; no faculty histories collected.

Full PhD overview read: exact Doctor of Philosophy in Business Administration, future academic faculty/publication mission, explicitly closely related Supply Chain research centre. Bordeaux/Marseille/Paris campuses shown; one programme, not three separate awards. Current PhD positions stated open, no individual intake date inferred.

Entire displayed curriculum read, both stage details present: research training, independent project with supervisor, three-paper thesis submitted and defended. Exact Doctor of Philosophy in Business Administration, distinct from executive DBA. No student enumeration.

Full centre research overview read: scientific methods/tools for supply-chain organization/transformation, explicit maritime/sustainable/4.0/urban logistics/analytics axes, doctoral researcher participation. Centre directly linked from actual PhD overview; linked Team list not opened.

Full displayed programme catalogue read, complete list without pagination. One Business Administration PhD, bachelor/master/MSc/certificates; no engineering doctorate. Executive-site DBA not relabelled PhD.

Full six-department inventory read: Audit/Control/Accounting/Economics/Law, Finance, Management, Marketing, MOSI, Strategy. No engineering department; Business Engineering programme reference on MOSI is not an IE department/doctorate.

limitations: Current source-bounded inventory coverage; no historical admissions/closure dates or uninterrupted offering inferred. Campus sites are not multiplied as providers. Executive DBA not converted into PhD.
